convention:
used everywhere in this study: 'peak' = half the peak-to-peak excursion of a sine of the same
power along the tremor's major axis (sqrt(2) x rms), in the page plane at the ink.  Rating-scale anchors are quoted
in their own convention (TETRAS limb items: cm; MDS-UPDRS: 'maximal amplitude'; tablet studies: peak-to-peak).

mild.basis: FTM spiral about 1: 1.1 mm peak (PDT-12); cohort median 1 mm peak (PDT-12)

moderate.basis: FTM about 2: 4.3 mm peak (PDT-12); about a third of the ET cohort above 2 mm peak (PDT-12 lognormal)

severe.basis: FTM 2.5-3: 8-17 mm peak (PDT-12); tablets lose very severe tremor (PDT-13)

f_Hz.basis: PDT-56 (4-12 Hz, typically 4-8, falling with age); PDT-36 (8-12 Hz in spirals, often unidirectional)

ET.while_writing: kinetic tremor: present while writing, often larger than postural (PDT-56); mostly one axis (PDT-36)

mild.basis: the typical PD writer with tremor: recorded drawing tremor 0.3-1.4 mm at the pen's sensor in 4 of 26 NewHandPD patients; UCI spirals <= 0.45 mm (REAL DATA, realdata.py)

moderate.basis: action or re-emergent tremor while writing in tremor-dominant PD (MDS-UPDRS 2: 1-3 cm maximal amplitude at the limb, PDT-68); ASSUMPTION at the pen

severe.basis: re-emergent tremor at rest-tremor amplitudes in pauses and slow strokes, off medication (PDT-09, PDT-65); ASSUMPTION at the pen

f_Hz.basis: PDT-56; PDT-09 (re-emergent about 5.5 Hz); recorded lines 4.4-5.9 Hz (REAL DATA)

PD.while_writing: rest tremor is suppressed by movement and re-emerges after a latency (PDT-09, PDT-56); action tremor persists; writing tremor proper in 10 % of PD (PDT-63)

prevalence.what: rest tremor / action tremor at baseline, 3 cohorts (PPMI 423, BioFIND 118, PDBP 873)
any tremor at least once over 7 years (PPMI, de novo, 397)
writing tremor in 100 consecutive PD patients (on medication)
prevalence.value: 10 % (26 % of those with postural/kinetic tremor); task-specific in 4 of 10

prevalence.what: tremor types in 315 PD patients with tremor
prevalence.value: pure rest 30 %; mixed rest + action at the same frequency 50 % (with a lag, i.e. re-emergent, 25 %); pure action 19 %; different frequencies 1 %
12 of 18 PD with rest tremor; latency 9.4 +- 10.7 s; about 5.5 Hz

prevalence.what: action tremor 'in nearly half' of PD patients when drawing (clinical review)

anchors.anchors: spiral: 1 barely visible, 2 obvious, 3 portions not recognisable, 4 not recognisable; handwriting: 1 untidy, 2 legible but considerable tremor, 3 parts illegible, 4 completely illegible
1 <= 1 cm; 2 > 1 but < 3 cm; 3 3-10 cm; 4 > 10 cm 'maximal amplitude'
log10 T(cm, p-p) = 0.6 FTM - 1.27; FTM 1: 2.1 mm, 2: 8.5 mm, 3: 34 mm peak-to-peak

label: LIT (ledger ids) + REAL DATA (realdata.py) + CALC; the class values are ASSUMPTION to be measured (EXP-W10)

stabpen.provenance.evidence_status: LITERATURE + REAL DATA + CALC (class values ASSUMPTION)
stabpen.provenance.command: run_study.py --stages light2 real calc targets realdata grip optimise summary figures
